column.harness: scripts/tyche_bench.py --support 8 --seeds 10 (best-of-16 candidates against the test mask,
column.input: whole image, grey min-max, resized to 128x128
column.readout: 16 candidates resized to native size, each > 0.5 (the best one is picked against the test mask by the column's SCORING, outside the clock)

clock: candidates(be, test image) > 0.5 (verbatim copy of scripts/tyche_bench.py:candidates): grey min-max, resize to 128 px, one pred_ged_stats call with target_size=16 (support read jointly with the query), sigmoid, to host, skimage resize of all 16 maps to native size, each > 0.5. The best-of-16 selection against the test mask is the column's scoring and is NOT timed
fit_detail: nothing is fitted: the 8 support pairs enter every forward pass
support_encode_detail: none: no support features are cached; the network reads the support inside every inference clock
support_prep_detail: fit(): the 8 support pairs resized to 128 px and copied to the GPU as [8,1,128,128] tensors, reused by every query; no network
